ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support and campus activity platform tailored for Desh Bhagat University students to navigate academics, events, and peer collaboration.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI: Collegiate Resource & Event Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets collegiate student needs directly and leverages a multi-agent LangGraph architecture similar to past hackathon winners, which deeply impresses academic judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated portfolio verification platform that uses generative AI to analyze student GitHub and project artifacts, generating verified trust badges and summaries for campus placement cells.
ideas.title: SkillCraft: AI-Driven Technical Portfolio & Trust Engine for Student Innovators
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the 'Career Growth' value proposition highlighted in the hackathon description by solving a real pain point for collegiate recruitment.

ideas.pitch: An interactive energy consumption and resource tracking platform for university campuses that gamifies sustainability through automated AI analytics.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI: Real-Time University Sustainability & Carbon Footprint Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven multi-agent and analytical patterns from sustainability hackathons to provide a visually compelling live dashboard for judges.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic quiz generation platform that turns hackathon mentor guidelines, project submissions, and technical documents into interactive, adaptive assessments in seconds.
ideas.title: HackQuiz AI: Instant Technical Assessment Generator for Hackathon Mentors
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts proven architectural patterns from award-winning educational tools that streamline evaluation and testing workflows.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition assistant customized for hostel and college mess menus, delivering personalized meal recommendations and health insights for students.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mimics a proven first-prize winner at a 24-hour hackathon, featuring a tightly scoped frontend and a robust AI recommendation loop.
